explorer.title: Restore explorer
explorer.subtitle: Browse any restore point of an account, then restore or download folders, files and mails.
explorer.empty: This folder is empty at this restore point.
explorer.emptyDescription: It may not have existed yet, or its contents were moved. Choose another restore point or go up one level.
explorer.emptyRoot: This restore point contains no items.
explorer.loadError: The folder could not be loaded.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.searchPlaceholder: Search mailboxes, OneDrives and IMAP accounts …
accounts.emptyDescription: Try a different search or a different type.

object.loadError: The protected mailboxes and drives could not be loaded.
object.noneDescription: Protect a mailbox, OneDrive or IMAP account first. It appears here as soon as it is protected, even before its first backup finishes.
object.noneSelf: Nothing of yours is backed up yet
object.noneSelfDescription: Your mailbox, OneDrive or IMAP account is not backed up yet. Ask your organisation's administrators to protect it.

restorePoint.noneDescription: This mailbox or drive has no restore point yet.
restorePoint.noneSelfDescription: This account has no restore point yet. Once its first backup has finished, you can restore from here. If the list stays empty, ask your administrators.
restorePoint.loadError: The restore points of this mailbox or drive could not be loaded.
restorePoint.truncatedHint: The newest {count} restore points of this account are shown. Older ones still exist but cannot be chosen here.

tree.label: Folders
tree.loadError: The folders could not be loaded.
tree.more: {count, plural, one {# more folder} other {# more folders}} in the list

selection.count: {count, plural, one {# entry selected} other {# entries selected}}
selection.covered: {name} is included through a selected folder

search.label: Search this restore point
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}} for “{query}”
search.noneDescription: The search covers names, paths and mail subjects at the selected restore point.
search.scope: Names, paths and subjects at this restore point were searched.
search.truncated: Only the first {shown} results are shown. Refine the search to narrow them down.

details.title: Details
details.empty: Select a mail, file or folder to see its details and versions.
details.deletedHint: The source had already deleted this item at this restore point. It can still be restored from here.
details.folderHint: Restoring a folder includes everything below it.

protection.notice: {kind, select, purview {Rights-protected by Microsoft Purview} smime {S/MIME-encrypted} other {Protected}}: opening the EML needs the recipient's rights; restoring into the mailbox works.
protection.downloadHint: {kind, select, purview {Rights-protected by Microsoft Purview} smime {S/MIME-encrypted} other {Protected}}: the downloaded EML needs the recipient's rights to open; restoring into the mailbox works.

reading.loadError: The message could not be loaded.

simplified.title: Simplified view
simplified.description: The formatted view of this message was too large to prepare. The text of the message is shown instead; images and layout are missing. Download the message to see all of it.

unavailable.rightsProtected: This message is rights-protected and cannot be shown here.
unavailable.smimeEncrypted: This message is S/MIME-encrypted and cannot be shown here.
unavailable.tooLarge: This message is too large to show here. Download it, or restore it into the mailbox instead.
unavailable.unsupportedFormat: This message was stored in a format that cannot be shown here. Download it, or restore it into the mailbox instead.
unavailable.unreadable: This message could not be read within the time and memory the preview is allowed to use. Download it, or restore it into the mailbox instead.

versions.title: Version history
versions.description: How this item looked at each restore point. Identical content across consecutive restore points is shown once.
versions.loadError: The version history could not be loaded.
versions.deletedHint: The source had deleted the item by this restore point; restore it from an earlier version.
versions.seenIn: Unchanged in {count, number} restore points since {first}
versions.onlyOne: No other versions are known for this item.

stored.title: Earlier versions kept by OneDrive
stored.description: OneDrive's own version history, captured with this restore point. These versions can be downloaded.

target.label: Restore to
target.originalDescription: Back into {object}, where the items came from.
target.originalDescriptionFolder: Into the account {object}, there into the new folder “{folder}” (see below: Keep both).
target.originalGone: The original account no longer exists in the source.
target.demoDownloadOnly: This demo only offers restore as a download.
target.otherDescription: Into a different mailbox, drive or IMAP account of this tenant.
target.otherRequiresAdmin: Only tenant admins can restore into another account.
target.downloadDescription: Mails as .eml, files as they are, with a checksum list. The link is valid for 24 hours.
target.onlyDownload: Earlier OneDrive versions are provided as a download.

accountHint.mailbox: The address of the target mailbox in the same Microsoft 365 tenant.
accountHint.onedrive: The user (UPN) or drive id of the target OneDrive; add :/Folder to restore into a subfolder.
accountHint.imap: The login of an IMAP account of this tenant.

mode.label: If an item already exists
mode.renameDescriptionMail: Nothing existing is touched: everything is restored into the new folder “{folder}”.
mode.renameDescriptionFiles: Nothing existing is touched: a file that already exists is restored under a new name.
mode.skipDescription: Items that are still there stay as they are; only missing items are restored.

reason.impersonationTitle: Restore on behalf of the owner
reason.impersonation: This data belongs to {owner}. The restore is recorded as an admin restore on their behalf.
reason.label: Reason
reason.placeholder: Ticket number or why this restore is needed
reason.help: Written to the tamper-evident audit log.

started.description: Follow the progress on the restore job page.

errors.title: The restore could not be started
errors.targetUnavailable: This target is not available for this restore.
errors.accountRequired: Enter the account to restore into.
errors.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.targetUnknown: This account is not known in this tenant. IMAP restores can only go into accounts of this tenant.
errors.selectionUnknown: Some selected entries no longer exist at this restore point. Reload the folder and select again.
errors.originalGone: The original account no longer exists. Restore into another account or download the data.
errors.queueUnavailable: The job queue is not available. Make sure the {appName} worker is running, then try again.
errors.snapshotGone: This restore point is no longer available. Choose another one.

jobs.title: Recent restores
jobs.subtitle: Restores and downloads of mailboxes, OneDrive and IMAP accounts, with progress and the result of each item. Restores onto machines are under File restore and in the machine's runs.
jobs.shown: {count, plural, one {The newest request is shown.} other {The newest # requests are shown.}}
jobs.emptyDescription: Restores and downloads you start in the explorer appear here with their progress.
jobs.loadError: The restores could not be loaded.

cancel.title: Cancel this restore?
cancel.description: The restore stops at the next item. What has already been restored stays in place.
cancel.descriptionDownload: The restore stops at the next item. No file is created: a ZIP only exists once the restore has run to the end.
cancel.failed: The restore could not be cancelled.

job.title: Restore job
job.subtitle: Progress, outcome and every item of this restore.
job.loadError: The restore job could not be loaded.

progress.title: Progress
progress.queued: Queued. Restores run before verifications and backups.
progress.failed: {count, plural, one {# item failed} other {# items failed}}
progress.eta: about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.cancelledDescription: Everything restored before the cancellation stays in place.
outcome.cancelledDescriptionDownload: No file was created: a ZIP only exists once the restore has run to the end. Request the download again.
outcome.noResult: The restore finished without reporting a result.
outcome.downloadExpiredDescription: The link was valid until {date}. Request the download again to get a new one.

request.title: Request
request.snapshotPruned: The restore point has since been removed by retention.

items.title: Items
items.description: What happened to each item, with the reason whenever it was not simply restored.
items.pending: The outcome of each item is shown once the restore has finished.
items.none: No per-item outcome was recorded for this restore.
items.liveFailures: Items that could not be restored so far:
items.failuresOnly: Items that could not be restored:
items.truncated: The {shown} items needing attention are listed first; {total} outcomes were reported in total.

codes.unverified: Restored, but the target's confirmation did not match the backup.
codes.exists: The target already holds this item.
codes.not_restorable: The backup holds no restorable content for this kind of item.
codes.parent_not_restored: Belongs to a message that was not restored.
codes.wrong_target: This kind of item cannot be restored into this target.
codes.data_missing: Data of this item is missing from the storage.
codes.integrity: The data did not pass the integrity check and was not restored.
codes.target_rejected: The target service refused the item.
codes.error: The item could not be restored.
